title: Preallocate bare aggregate collectors

summary: Added a bounded input capacity hint for AggregateAccumulator.
Added with_input_capacity for collecting accumulators: COUNT_DISTINCT, ARRAY_AGG, STRING_AGG, and GROUP_CONCAT.
Changed bare aggregate execution to initialize accumulators from rows.len() through the bounded helper.
Left group-by accumulator initialization unchanged to avoid per-group over-preallocation.
Added unit coverage for the bounded capacity helper and collector preallocation.
